title: Apply untrusted-content policy on production tool and swarm paths
goal: VC-201-074 remains not delivered: route tool output, retrieved bodies, MCP/A2A replies, and file/URL content through a typed untrusted boundary before consequential actions; reject embedded permission or command instructions and redact credential requests from result, trace, and error sinks. The current wrap_tool_output/policy_allows helper has no production call sites.
